atlases.prompt: Create one coherent production PROP ATLAS for the Mermaid Roshan picture-book lower borders. Six isolated small illustrated props in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, one prop/group per cell, evenly sized cells with generous transparent gutters. TRUE transparent RGBA background, including holes between objects. No checkerboard pixels, paper rectangle, labels, captions, frame, ground, floor, environment, characters, faces or cast-shadow planes. Reference image is style only: delicate blue-purple/navy outlines, simple pastel watercolor forms, broad value bands, clear child-readable shapes; no photorealism, glossy 3D rendering or tiny noisy detail. Props will be used at 0.4–0.6 inch high, so clarity matters. Each entire group fits comfortably inside its own cell with 15% inset; nothing crosses grid boundaries. Landscape atlas. BATHROOM accessories. Top-left: pale pearl shell soap dish holding a rounded pink bar of soap, no bubbles. Top-middle: two neatly folded aqua washcloths with a lavender edge. Top-right: a simple gold shell-shaped comb with clearly separated rounded teeth. Bottom-left: cheerful plain yellow rubber duck, no face embellishments, no water patch. Bottom-middle: one rolled pale-lavender towel with its blue hem visible. Bottom-right: small pearlescent lidded bath-salts jar with a shell-shaped lid, no lettering. These suggest sink cleaning and a fresh tidy bath, not another brush/sponge.
atlases.method: Built-in imagegen, one transparent prop atlas. Original atlas unchanged; PDF clips each whole object at recorded bounds.

pages.event: Getting ready to help: folded cloths and supply basket
Sink accessories beside a freshly cleaned basin
Bath ready to use again: duck, dry towel and bath salts
Poolside collection: float and rubbish basket; no duplicate net contents
Rescue opens the way to play: blocks and soft ball
Playing together: sailboat, stacking cups and interlocking pieces
Sorting creative supplies: ribbons, crayons and scissors
Everything has a place: sorted buttons, stacked paper and glitter
A long-closed doorway: tarnished knocker, cobweb and keepsake chest
Dusty attic discoveries: old chest, web and curled fluff
Bounce and sparkle: disturbed fluff beside small iridescent glints
Helping each other: pieces that fit and a tied pair of pennants
An invitation to play: rainbow toy, shared ball and blocks

review: All four atlases inspected: whole isolated props, actual alpha. Manual cell boundaries avoid cutting the sorting tray and cobweb shell group.
